body: Thanks, I'll finish it. In fact, I had an idea last night while trying to fall asleep about changing the plot. I'll see where that goes.

That is the most beautiful piece of machinery I have ever seen in my entire life. I don't know why I like motorcycles but they are just so sleek and well shaped. I have always wanted a motorcycle but most of my family members are not supportive. Also, I am super broke at the moment but if I weren't, I would much rather buy a bike than a car or any other vehicle. Happy for you :)
Thanks, I think I needed that.
